description: Source code for SQLStore implementation managing database interactions in the focalboard server, including connection setup, version checks, and SQL query helpers.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Represents a SQL database store with methods for database operations and configuration.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new SQLStore instance with provided parameters, initializes schema, and performs migrations.

methods.name: IsMariaDB
methods.description: Checks if the connected database is MariaDB.

methods.name: computeBinaryParam
methods.description: Determines if the data source uses binary_parameters for Postgres.

methods.name: getQueryBuilder
methods.description: Provides a SQL query builder with appropriate placeholder format.

methods.name: escapeField
methods.description: Escapes SQL field names based on database type.

methods.name: concatenationSelector
methods.description: Returns SQL string for concatenating fields with delimiters based on database type.

methods.name: elementInColumn
methods.description: Generates SQL condition for element presence in a column.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns license info; currently returns nil.

methods.name: searchUserChannels
methods.description: Searches user channels; not supported in standalone mode.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves a channel; not supported in standalone mode.
